description: This file defines classes related to course data management in a Flutter application. It includes a data model 'CourseSummary' for lightweight course listings and a provider class 'CoursesProvider' that manages course data fetching, supporting both mock data and real API calls.

classes.name: CourseSummary
classes.description: A lightweight data model representing a course with essential details such as id, title, teacher, number of lessons, and rating.

classes.name: CoursesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based provider that manages the list of courses, handles loading state, and fetches course summaries from either mock data or via API.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads course data; uses mock service if EnvConfig.useMocks is true, otherwise intended to call a real API (commented out). Manages loading state and notifies listeners.
